or missile.

भुशुंडिः --डी f. A sort of weapon
or missile.

भूष् {c1c} P., {c10c} U. (भूषति, भूषयति-ते,
भूषित)
1 To adorn, deck, decorate
शुचि भूषयति श्रुतं वपुः Bk. 20. 15.
--2
To decorate oneself (Atm.); भूषयते
कम्या स्वयमेव.
--3 To spread or strew
with, overspread; R. 2. 31. --WITH
अभि to adorn, grace, give beauty
to; Śi. 7. 38.

भूषणं [भूष्येतऽनेन भूष्-करणे ल्युट्]
1
Ornamenting, decoration.
--2 An
ornament, decoration, an article of
decoration; क्षीयंते खलु भूषणानि सततं
वाग्भूषणं भूषणं Bh. 2. 19; R. 3. 2;
13. 57.
--णः N. of Viṣṇu.

भूषा [भूष्-भावे अ]
1 Decorating,
adorning.
--2 An ornament,
decoration; as in कर्णभूषा q. v.
--3 A jewel.

भूषित p. p. [भूष्-क्त] Decorated,
ornamented; मणिना भूषितः सर्पः
किमसौ न भयंकरः.

भूष्णु a. [भू-ग्ष्णु]
1 Being,
becoming; as in अलंभूष्णु q. v.
--2
Wishing for wealth or prosperity;
Ms. 4. 135.
